Export the HSL pair, rgbToHsl and hslToRgb, and the Hsl type (rich-palette-xovz.yo3) (#609)

* Export the HSL pair, rgbToHsl and hslToRgb, and the Hsl type (rich-palette-xovz.yo3)

cc-dump-web places its category colors in HSL and holds floors with
ensureContrast; it now imports the pair darken runs on instead of carrying a
copy. Exported, hslToRgb is total over its type: a hue wraps mod 360, and a
non-finite hue or s/l outside [0,1] throws RangeError. darken's inputs were
already in range, so its output is unchanged.

* Document the HSL pair on the adjust page; darken names a NaN level itself; drop the barrel-identity assertions (rich-palette-xovz.yo3 review)

* Drop darken's second NaN check; pin hslToRgb's non-finite and boundary inputs; the docs label reads the hue back (rich-palette-xovz.yo3 review)
CLAUDE.md: performance is a count of work, never a clock; load tests are banned
The unclosed-links linearity test starts at 4,000 links, so a saturated suite stays well clear of the hang limit (rich-unfiled-791c.m154)
